mechanisms.description: the population drifts toward higher-risk accounts
the offer's effect weakens and then turns negative
labels arrive one month later than the strategy expects

replay: each strategy drives its own trajectory: its contacts change churn, contact history and who is still active, so two strategies face different cohorts within a few months. No strategy is re-scored on another's log.
scope_note: A mock world, not evidence about any operator. 40 worlds per mechanism is a sensitivity study; the paired standard errors are reported so nobody reads a small difference as an established one. The reward is prevented churn, not money: there is no cost ledger.
